## What's Changed
* Show stacked token and cost breakdowns in session stats by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/8
* Release 0.3.0 by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/9


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0

## What's Changed
* Remove the /session-stats-settings slash entry point by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/1
* Open the detailed stats dialog when the sidebar block or footer total is clicked by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/2
* Fix "Cursor cannot be combined with order" when a session has more than one page of steps by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/3
* Redesign the stats dialog: wide layout, summary cards, token mix and cost-share bars by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/4
* Mark the sidebar block as clickable with a [+] and brighten it on hover by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/5
* Label models with no recorded price as (sub) instead of $0.00 by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/6
* Release 0.2.0 by @championswimmer in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/7

## New Contributors
* @championswimmer made their first contribution in https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/championswimmer/opencode-cost-stats/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
